contract.physical_partition_wal_dedup: N/A: ordinary view; no physical write or UPSERT key
contract.projected_date: trade_date TIMESTAMP carrying a calendar date at UTC midnight
contract.nullability: Required date and four LONG counts; avg_pct_change and total_amount_yi preserve null.
contract.units: avg_pct_change remains percentage points; total_amount_yi already equals source amount/100000, no second conversion.
contract.ddl: Existing formal alias retained and strictly checked; only missing private fixture alias created. No formal CREATE/ALTER/REPLACE.

source_owner.call_chain: CLI lifecycle installs/validates MV and activates alias; native repository branch SELECTs alias; application and market_ui consume breadth history and KPI.
source_owner.python_native_read_limitation: Native SELECT branch identifies alias by MV name in SQL and does not independently refuse an invalid MV. Java checks the exact alias and native contract plus freshness.
source_owner.cache_fallback: Python cache applies to non-native path; no Java cache publication in D096.

acceptance.source_evidence: D095 final real-source acceptance; complete 11105+5553 rows, not synthetic rows.
acceptance.direct_write: Rejected by READ-only DatasetDefinition; no view DML.
acceptance.checkpoint_before_after: N/A for ordinary view; no new checkpoint or materialization run. D095 existing verified coverage remains separate.
acceptance.read_resume: nextCursor contains full date key, query fingerprint and alias+MV version; drift rejects continuation.

formal_readonly.read_group_state: FAILED, no page; not successful empty

fault_checks.alias_contract: Fixed alias policy; wrong/missing dependency, invalid alias, wrong SQL, SQL/directory/status drift rejected.
fault_checks.native_contract: D095 base must be stk_factor and aggregate SQL must match the frozen native contract; wrong base or aggregation rejected at first read.
fault_checks.mv_state: Invalid/lagging/unsettled/suspended MV rejected; base/MV rebuild or physical change invalidates cursor.
fault_checks.typed_mapping: Seven fields, required values, UTC midnight, null aggregates, counts, overflow and nonfinite values tested.
fault_checks.read_group: Actual configured typed binding and strict JSON request parsing verified; cancellation refuses reads.
fault_checks.legacy_views: StockBasicDataset.LATEST ordinary-table dependency retains original reader behavior.
fault_checks.network_retry: Bounded SELECT/JDBC timeout; no write retry or unknown ACK in a VIEW-only read.

known_limitations: Formal MV remains invalid and stale; isolated acceptance does not repair formal production data.
D096 owns typed reads and resumes using a guarded cursor; native refresh uses the canonical D095 job, without a second writer.
Actual live samples contain non-null measures; null and malformed carriers are implementation fault tests.
